narrative: On the plot. Pasteboard on the peg, ruled into boxes, the hand a copyist's. Four boxes are near enough to read. The rest of the board is smaller than he bothers with.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the four boxes, and did not unpeg the board.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: The hand is his. He was not beside the peg for this.

entities.name: Richard the Second
entities.context: Shown on plot in Four boxes
